bio: Brad Davis served on the brass instructional staff of the Pacific Crest Drum and Bugle Corps, where he helped develop the corps' brass program over a three-year period in consultation with UCLA's Gordon Henderson and DCI Hall of Fame member Frank Williams. By the 2015 season he held the role of Assistant Caption Head and Trumpet Instructor with Pacific Crest's brass team.

Caleb Gasteiger is a percussion educator who has worked with the Blue Stars Drum and Bugle Corps, contributing to the corps' battery and visual percussion instruction. He has also served as a bass drum instructor with Dark Sky Percussion.
